correction: Split screen C into C0 (identity precondition and adapter liveness, no quality claim, no threshold) and C1 (adapted ceiling on features from a bounded preregistered closed-form layer-11 adaptation fitted on unique supervised train page texts only, same FP64 lstsq procedure and same development unique-text family-macro MAE threshold 0.3332298906765268). C1 runs after A and B and after the bounded adaptation, before the full development fit. C1 fail retires encoder adaptation for this assay; C1 pass permits the full development fit.
defect: Screen C was specified to encode features with the adapted final layer at adapter init identity 1.0 and to require an identity precondition that this reproduces frozen page features within 1e-5 absolute. At identity 1.0 that precondition holds by construction, so the screen necessarily reproduces the retired page-only development ceiling MAE 0.3832298906765268 and returns fail against threshold 0.3332298906765268. Screen C runs before any optimizer step, so no fitting could change it. As written it is a gate that cannot pass and would retire encoder adaptation without testing it.
evidence_for_defect: The screens implementation independently reproduced rank 180, retained condition 221.8066 and development family-macro MAE 0.3832298906765268 over 240 unique texts from the retired page-only artifacts, confirming the identity path reproduces the failed ceiling exactly. No adaptation, development or final outcome was observed before the defect was found.
forbidden_now: Do not run screen C as originally specified and record its degenerate fail as a mechanism result. Do not move the C1 threshold. Do not tune the C1 fit population, normalizer or solver.
what_this_changes: C1 costs one bounded closed-form adaptation on unique train page texts before the full fit. That is the minimum spend that makes a ceiling screen a genuine test instead of an identity check. It opens no final pool, selects no model and uses no development or final outcome to choose the adaptation.
